practical: Review of sample radiographs to identify defects and discuss safety protocols
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of radiographic inspection?
Name two sources used for generating radiation in NDT.
Why is safety precaution critical when handling X-ray equipment?

development.content:
Principle of radiographic inspection
Interaction of radiation with matter
Shadow formation and motion blur
Types of recording media

X-ray and Gamma ray sources
Applicability of radiography
Types of test specimens

Safety precautions during X-ray use
Regulatory limits for exposure
Emergency procedures for radiation leaks

summary_questions: Explain how a radiographic shadow indicates a defect in a specimen.
Differentiate between X-ray and Gamma ray sources in terms of applicability.
List three essential safety precautions when operating X-ray equipment.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report comparing the principle and applications of neutron radiography discussed in the next lesson (LP 06) with the X-ray radiography covered in this session.
